name: Q0b: coordination with no owners
about: q0 with nobody owning any module: the change request (pricing per flight minute) could be built by anyone, in the scheduler, in pricing or in the report. Same arms, skeleton and acceptance as q0; only ownership is removed, so who builds it is a real coordination question.
brief: **This is a very short run (about 3 minutes of work).** The planner already works and `npm test` passes. Shortly after you start, the product manager lands a change request (`CHANGE-REQUEST.md` on main, and a `- [pm] CHANGE REQUEST ...` line in NOTES.md). Nobody is assigned: the team decides who does what. Build it once, between you, without stepping on each other.

roles.a1: **You work on the whole codebase; there are no module owners.**
roles.a2: **You work on the whole codebase; there are no module owners.**
roles.a3: **You work on the whole codebase; there are no module owners.**

stop: Stop as soon as the change request is on main and `npm test` passes there, or at minute 3 (`date` against when you started), whichever comes first. Don't wait for teammates to finish.
